Clip · Head of Design (Employee 2) · 2013–2016

Clip Terminal: bringing card acceptance to Mexico

  • $1B+
    Pesos processed
  • 7.7M+
    Transactions
  • 30K+
    Merchants

Clip set out to bring credit card acceptance to a cash-based society. When I joined as employee #2, credit card penetration in Mexico sat at roughly 12%, and the bar to start accepting cards as a small business was nearly impossible — multiple bank relationships, expensive hardware, and a customer base afraid of fraud and "card cloning" devices.

I led research, UX, and visual design for the MVP terminal app on iOS, Android, and Windows Phone. The team validated each iteration at monthly pop-up mercados in Mexico City — watching real merchants attempt to swipe before entering an amount, learning that our bright orange readers were a trust signal because the black ones were what fraudsters used. Those insights worked their way back into the app, the hardware, and the brand.
